description: Log in with email and password of a verified Safe Mind account and create an API key. Call this before any company, survey or analytics tool unless SAFE_MIND_API_KEY is already set. The key is kept in memory for this session only and also returned, so the user can store it as SAFE_MIND_API_KEY for later sessions. Fails if the email is not verified yet (use safe_mind_verify_email) or the credentials are wrong.

email.description: Email address of the verified Safe Mind account.

name: safe_mind_get_api_key
